topic: Tata Steel and APL Apollo Mega Consolidation Deal Market Reaction
summary: Following the approval of the massive ₹28,000–₹32,266 crore transaction, the deal has sparked significant share price volatility and erased over ₹30,700 crore in market capitalization as shareholders digest the debt and structural changes.

topic: Crude Oil Prices Drop to Multi-Month Lows
